verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a vendor-hosted checkout, Mollie Checkout, where customers select a payment method and complete payment on Mollie-hosted pages. The docs present it as an alternative to building your own checkout and say the pages are optimized for phones, tablets and other common devices. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of conversion optimization, and detail on the redirect flow mechanics (e.g., checkout URL and redirect handling)
